scope: Native normal-world Login character create/list/delete with source-derived encrypted TCP; world entry/save/gameplay remain pending
intentional_modern_repairs: One PostgreSQL transaction includes directory, character, inventory, skills, title, cabinet, hotkeys, mail, recall, mount and item allocator; source commits at multiple stages.

Native create/delete require current unlocked agreed session key and process owner fence; account row version serializes cross-world operations. Retry only confirmed serialization/deadlock aborts, never unknown commit outcomes.
Composite world/character foreign keys cascade low-level deletion; titles are cleaned instead of preserving the source orphan-title defect. Account mount remains as in the source.
TRECALLMONTABLE.dwID gets modern identity: source procedure expects identity but backup table has no default/identity.
wCustomTex is an explicit empty-zero protocol extension, not a recovered backup column.
New runtime timestamps use UTC rounded to minutes; historical naive timestamps are not converted.

Conflicting account original countries, missing attributes, unknown veteran options, non-player race/class and unsupported positive signed-BIGINT item worlds fail closed instead of guessed fallback values.
Six client slot indices per world; count across all worlds is not misinterpreted as remaining slots. Counts beyond original BYTE range fail closed.
pending_contracts: Actual original client executable and code-page acceptance; current peer derives frames from source only.

Historical reserved/keeping names contain owner references and are not imported into empty current accounts. Modern reservations are operator-provisioned; current keeping patterns use PostgreSQL LIKE (% and _), not full SQL Server bracket grammar.
Non-ASCII character names and full SQL Server collation equivalence; native creation currently accepts the US ASCII profile.
Multi-world item allocator provenance other than original world zero must be reviewed by the operator. Item-world values 128+ unsupported pending signed/wire range contract.
